scholarships.title: NextGen Digital Skills Scholarship – 2027
scholarships.desc:
Provider: Digital Horizons Education Initiative (DHEI)
Category: Technology / Skills Development Scholarship
Scholarship Type: Undergraduate Financial Assistance
Academic Year: 2026–2027

Digital Horizons Education Initiative (DHEI) is now accepting applications for its NextGen Digital Skills Scholarship for Academic Year 2026–2027.

This scholarship program aims to support college students pursuing technology-related degrees who demonstrate academic potential, creativity, and a strong interest in developing digital solutions.

The initiative is designed to help aspiring technology professionals gain access to educational resources and improve their technical knowledge. Selected applicants will receive financial assistance to support their academic expenses and participation in technology-related learning activities.

Scholarship Benefits

Selected scholars will receive ₱10,000 in educational assistance for the academic year. They will also gain access to online technology workshops, introductory programming sessions, and digital career development seminars organized by DHEI.

Eligibility Requirements

Applicants must be Filipino citizens currently enrolled in a recognized Philippine college or university. They must be taking a bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or another related program.

Applicants must have a GWA of 2.50 or better in the previous semester, demonstrate an interest in technology and digital innovation, and maintain good academic standing. Students from financially challenged households are encouraged to apply.

Application Process

Interested students must complete the online application form through the NEXO scholarship portal and upload all required documents before submitting their application.

Applications will be evaluated based on academic performance, eligibility, and demonstrated interest in technology. Only the first 10 successfully submitted applications will be accepted by the system. Once the maximum applicant limit has been reached, additional submissions will no longer be accepted.

Important Reminder: Meeting the applicant limit does not guarantee scholarship selection. Only five applicants will be selected as scholarship beneficiaries after the evaluation process.

scholarships.title: Kabataang May Bukas Educational Opportunity Grant – 2027
scholarships.desc:
Provider: Kabataang May Bukas Development Network, Inc. (KMB-DN)
Category: Needs-Based / Community Development Scholarship
Scholarship Type: Undergraduate Educational Assistance
Academic Year: 2026–2027

Kabataang May Bukas Development Network, Inc. (KMB-DN) is inviting applications for its Educational Opportunity Grant for Academic Year 2026–2027.

The program is designed to help Filipino students facing financial difficulties continue their college education. It prioritizes individuals from low-income households, underserved communities, and families experiencing economic challenges.

KMB-DN believes that financial circumstances should not prevent young people from pursuing their educational goals. Through this initiative, the organization aims to provide financial assistance while encouraging volunteerism, community participation, and personal development among its beneficiaries.

Scholarship Benefits

Selected beneficiaries will receive ₱12,000 in educational assistance per academic year, distributed in two installments of ₱6,000 per semester. They will also receive a learning materials package, access to free online skills development sessions, and opportunities to participate in community outreach and youth empowerment activities organized by the NGO.

Eligibility Requirements

Applicants must be Filipino citizens currently enrolled in a recognized college or university in the Philippines. They must belong to a household with a combined monthly income not exceeding ₱20,000 and must have obtained a GWA of 2.75 or better in the previous semester.

Applicants must demonstrate genuine financial need, maintain satisfactory academic standing, and show willingness to participate in community development activities. Students from rural communities, single-parent households, and families experiencing financial hardship will receive priority consideration.

Applicants must not be receiving another full scholarship that covers the same educational expenses.

Application Process

Interested students must complete the application form through the NEXO scholarship portal and upload all required supporting documents before the application deadline.

The KMB-DN Selection Committee will assess applicants based on financial need, academic standing, household circumstances, and community involvement. Selected candidates may be contacted for a short online interview or additional verification of submitted information.

Successful applicants will receive an official notification containing the scholarship guidelines, release schedule, and beneficiary responsibilities.

Important Reminder: Priority consideration does not guarantee scholarship approval. All information and supporting documents must be accurate and verifiable. Selected beneficiaries are encouraged to participate in the organization's youth development and community outreach initiatives.

scholarships.title: PCSA National Student Excellence Scholarship Program – AY 2026–2027
scholarships.desc:
Provider: Philippine Commission for Student Advancement (PCSA)
Category: Academic / Merit-Based Scholarship
Scholarship Type: Undergraduate Financial Assistance
Academic Year: 2026–2027

The Philippine Commission for Student Advancement (PCSA) is accepting applications for its National Student Excellence Scholarship Program for Academic Year 2026–2027.

This program aims to support academically performing Filipino college students who demonstrate consistent academic achievement, leadership potential, and active participation in their communities.

Selected scholars will receive financial assistance to help cover educational expenses, including tuition fees, learning materials, transportation, and other school-related costs.

The program is open to qualified undergraduate students currently enrolled in recognized higher education institutions in the Philippines

Scholarship Benefits

1. ₱20,000 financial assistance per academic year
2. ₱10,000 released per semester
3. Educational allowance for books and learning materials
4. Certificate of recognition from PCSA
5. Opportunity to participate in student leadership and development activities

Eligibility Requirements

Applicants must:

1. Be a Filipino citizen.
2.  Be currently enrolled as a regular undergraduate student in a recognized Philippine higher education institution.
3. Have a General Weighted Average (GWA) of 1.75 or better in the previous academic year.
4. Have no failing grades, incomplete grades, or unresolved academic deficiencies.
5. Demonstrate good moral character.
6. Have no other full government-funded scholarship covering the same educational expenses.

Application Process

Interested students must complete the online application form and upload all required documents through the NEXO scholarship portal.

Only applications with complete and valid documents will proceed to the evaluation stage. Shortlisted applicants may be contacted for document verification before the final selection.

Important Reminder: Submission of an application does not guarantee scholarship approval. PCSA reserves the right to verify submitted information and disqualify applications containing inaccurate or misleading details.

scholarships.title: BrightPath Future Achievers Scholarship – AY 2026–2027
scholarships.desc:
Provider: BrightPath Educational Foundation, Inc.
Category: Merit and Financial Need-Based Scholarship
Scholarship Type: Undergraduate Educational Assistance
Academic Year: 2026–2027

BrightPath Educational Foundation, Inc. is now accepting applications for its Future Achievers Scholarship Program for Academic Year 2026–2027.

The program aims to help deserving Filipino college students continue their education despite financial challenges. It recognizes students who demonstrate academic commitment, perseverance, and a strong desire to contribute positively to their communities.

Through this initiative, BrightPath seeks to provide financial support to students who have the potential to succeed but need additional assistance to pursue their educational goals.

Scholarship Benefits

1. ₱15,000 educational allowance per academic year
2. ₱7,500 financial assistance per semester
3. Additional ₱2,000 book and learning materials allowance
4. Access to free online career development workshops
5. Mentorship opportunities with volunteer professionals

Eligibility Requirements

Applicants must:

1. Be a Filipino citizen currently residing in the Philippines.
2. Be enrolled as a second-year, third-year, or fourth-year undergraduate student.
3. Have a General Weighted Average (GWA) of 2.25 or better in the previous semester.
4. Come from a household with a combined monthly income not exceeding ₱30,000.
5. Demonstrate active participation in school, community, or volunteer activities.
6. Have no existing full scholarship covering tuition and educational expenses.
7. Be willing to participate in at least one foundation-organized development activity during the scholarship period.

scholarships.title: San Isidro Local Student Assistance Program (SILSAP) – AY 2026–2027
scholarships.desc:
Provider: City of San Isidro – Youth and Education Development Office
Category: Financial Assistance / Local Government Scholarship
Scholarship Type: Undergraduate Educational Assistance
Academic Year: 2026–2027

The City Government of San Isidro, through its Youth and Education Development Office, is pleased to announce the opening of applications for the San Isidro Local Student Assistance Program (SILSAP) for Academic Year 2026–2027.

This initiative aims to provide financial assistance to qualified college students who are residents of San Isidro and belong to low-income households. The program supports the local government's commitment to making higher education more accessible and reducing the financial challenges faced by students and their families.

Qualified beneficiaries will receive educational assistance to help cover school-related expenses, including transportation, learning materials, project requirements, and other academic necessities.

Scholarship Benefits

Selected beneficiaries will receive ₱8,000 in financial assistance per semester, equivalent to ₱16,000 for the academic year. They will also be given priority access to free career orientation sessions, local youth development activities, and educational programs organized by the city government.

Eligibility Requirements

Applicants must be bona fide residents of San Isidro for at least two years. They must be Filipino citizens currently enrolled in a recognized college or university for AY 2026–2027 and must belong to a household with a combined monthly income not exceeding ₱25,000.

Applicants must have obtained a GWA of 2.50 or better during the previous semester, maintain good academic standing, and have no record of serious disciplinary violations. Priority will be given to students from financially disadvantaged households and those who have not received another full government-funded scholarship.

Application Process

Interested students must complete the online application through the NEXO scholarship portal and upload all required documents before the deadline. Applicants must ensure that their residency and household income information are accurate and verifiable.

The Youth and Education Development Office will evaluate applications based on residency, household financial circumstances, academic performance, and completeness of submitted documents. Shortlisted applicants may be required to attend an interview or undergo additional document verification at the designated city government office.

Important Reminder: This program is intended exclusively for qualified residents of San Isidro. Submission of an application does not guarantee selection. False declarations, incomplete requirements, or unverifiable information may result in disqualification.

scholarships.title: NexaCore Tech Innovators Scholarship – AY 2026–2027
scholarships.desc:
Provider: NexaCore Technologies Corporation
Category: STEM / Technology Education Scholarship
Scholarship Type: Corporate Academic and Financial Assistance
Academic Year: 2026–2027

NexaCore Technologies Corporation is opening applications for its Tech Innovators Scholarship Program for Academic Year 2026–2027.

The program aims to support promising Filipino college students pursuing degrees in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, and other technology-related disciplines.

Through this initiative, NexaCore seeks to encourage innovation, strengthen digital skills, and help develop the next generation of technology professionals. Selected scholars will receive financial assistance and opportunities to participate in professional development activities organized by the company.

Scholarship Benefits

Selected scholars will receive ₱25,000 in educational assistance per academic year, distributed in two semester installments of ₱12,500. Additional benefits include access to selected technical training sessions, career development workshops, mentorship opportunities with IT professionals, and priority consideration for internship opportunities at NexaCore, subject to available positions and qualifications.

Eligibility Requirements

Applicants must be Filipino citizens currently enrolled in a recognized Philippine college or university. They must be taking a bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or another related STEM program.

Applicants must have a GWA of 2.00 or better in the previous academic year and must demonstrate an interest in technology, innovation, software development, or digital solutions. They must also be in good academic and disciplinary standing and must not be receiving another full corporate or government scholarship covering the same expenses.

Priority will be given to students who have participated in programming competitions, technology projects, research activities, or relevant extracurricular organizations.

Application Process

Interested applicants must complete the online application through the NEXO scholarship portal and submit all required documents before the deadline.

The NexaCore Scholarship Committee will evaluate applicants based on academic performance, degree program relevance, interest in technology, and submitted project experiences. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to an online interview to discuss their academic background, technical interests, and career aspirations.

Important Reminder: Submission of a portfolio is encouraged but not mandatory. Scholarship recipients may be invited to participate in company-sponsored learning activities. Internship opportunities are subject to separate screening and do not guarantee employment with NexaCore Technologies Corporation.
